pages.text: Altered from $(5)Luck Of The Sea$(), $(4)Maritime Snare$() enables the chance to fish out an aquatic creature alongside the usual fishing loot, with the level increasing the potential size of it. Maximum level is $(4)III$() and it conflicts with $(5)Luck Of The Sea$().

pages.title: Notes
pages.text: The occasional creatures can spice up an otherwise monotonous fishing session, with some of the possible catches being quite exotic, such as Guardians. If one wishes to obtain a specific creature, such as a Pufferfish, they may want to use a level I Maritime Snare, to shrink the possible pool. Level II includes medium sized creatures, and III has the larger ones within it too.
